$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFFO (AIP France, chart dated 2022-06-16): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Beauvoir - Fromentine

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
AD reserved for home-based ACFT.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
AD prohibited to paramotors.
Unpaved RWY unusable after strong rains: ask to the AD operator.
Paved HEL landing area: FATO: 27 x 27 m, embedded white lights.
TLOF: 11.4 x 11.4 m, embedded green lights.
No Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
AD very sensitive to the noise.
Avoid overflying inhabited neighboring areas.
School flying activity reserved for associations with prior authorization from AD operator.
Training or school traffic patterns reserved for homebased ACFT.
Low height pattern for training flights with instructor pilot: 600 ft AAL North and South of RWY.
AD accessible to helicopters by day when unpaved runway is closed.
The Beauvoir-L'Ile d'Yeu connection is authorized to make a straight-in approach RWY 10.
Opening at night for helicopters with 24 hours notice to the operator and without notice for rescue operations.
At night, preferential approach and take-off axes of the helipad are those of the unpaved runway (099° and 279°).
The parking stand must be cleared.
Parachuting activity on AD (NR 214): SFC/FL 135.
15 APR - 15 OCT: SAT, SUN, public HOL: SR-SS.
Activity reserved for users authorized by DSAC-O / Pays-de-la-Loire delegation and according to protocol.
Users' information on NANTES Information or NANTES Approach FREQ.
